about: Photo look with real NASA and Webb pictures: the search for life beyond Earth.

scenes.narration: Life is known on exactly one world. This one.
Since nineteen ninety five, astronomers have found more than six thousand planets around other stars. Our galaxy probably holds more planets than stars.
Saturn's moon Enceladus sprays water from a hidden ocean into space. Jupiter's moon Europa holds more water than all of Earth's oceans.
On Mars, a rock with strange leopard spots could be a sign of ancient life. Or not. No one can say yet.

image.credit: NASA, ESA, and S. Beckwith (STScI) and the HUDF Team (CC BY 4.0)

scenes.narration: The galaxy is old and vast. So where is everybody? Perhaps life is rare. Perhaps we are early. Perhaps we have not listened long enough.
Two Voyager spacecraft carry a golden record of sounds and pictures from Earth, a message for anyone who finds them.

image.credit: NASA, ESA, CSA, STScI; J. DePasquale, A. Koekemoer, A. Pagan (STScI) (CC BY 4.0)

scenes.narration: Finding even a single microbe out there would change how we see ourselves forever.
